title: typha domingensis var. angustata
intro: Typha domingensis var. angustata, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Cattail or Narrow-leaved Cattail Typha, is a perennial aquatic plant belonging to the Typhaceae family. This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including wounds, infections, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Typha domingensis var. angustata include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may contribute to its wound-healing and antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
